scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful rough edges; 10 exceptional across assessed mobile interaction. Holistic overall is not an arithmetic average and is not determined by wins. Provisional to this emulated, paused sample.

controls.reason: Large FIRE and contextual hold actions, tap aim, manual reload and simultaneous route/fire worked. Tap-induced view changes and frequent target reacquisition add friction; free stick movement and drag aim not sufficiently assessed.

gameplay.reason: Complete recover-disable-upload arc with visible coil states and enemy pressure. Much traversal/recovery was accomplished by holding one assisted action, reducing active decision variety in this sample; cover hits and rear attacks were frustrating. Continuous combat depth and enjoyment unassessed.

presentation.reason: Cohesive rainy industrial setting, teal/amber accents, readable primary objective hierarchy and polished victory panel; dark surfaces can obscure threats. Audio unassessed.

usability.reason: Opening instructions, contextual recover/approach/face controls, route markers, map and unambiguous START FRESH made both missions finishable without a blocker. Auxiliary RELOAD is an extra tray interaction.

readability.reason: Health/ammo, large buttons, coil percentages and upload status are clear. Secondary hints, compass/time, map labels and the dense terminal stat line are small at 844x390; notices and controls occupy substantial scene space.

findings.finding: Explicit opening input instructions and assisted path/recovery actions support visible progress.
COVER/INERT COVER feedback occurred after firing; target aim and target exposure were not always easy to judge visually.
Discrete OFF indicators and upload percentage make mission state legible.
Rear threat notices describe danger outside the current scene; no causal difficulty claim from this paused test.

uncertainties: Expected source SHA supplied by requester; repository/source never inspected, so identity only confirmed by visible BUILD 101 title. No visible identity mismatch.
